records.question: What is the approved sales quantity in base cups?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(s.qty * CASE WHEN s.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS total_base_cups FROM sales AS s JOIN materials AS m ON s.material_id = m.material_id WHERE s.status = 'approved' LIMIT 200

records.question: What is the posted stock-out quantity in base cups, including waste?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(so.qty * CASE WHEN so.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS total_cups FROM stock_out AS so JOIN materials AS m ON so.material_id = m.material_id WHERE so.status = 'posted' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many distinct approved sales documents are there?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_code) FROM sales WHERE status = 'approved' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many approved sales-return document lines are there?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sales_returns WHERE status = 'C' LIMIT 200

records.question: What is the approved refund total in CNY excluding tax, expressed as a positive amount?
records.final_sql: SELECT ABS(SUM(refund_net)) AS refund_total FROM sales_returns WHERE status = 'C' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many base cups were returned on approved sales returns, expressed as a positive quantity?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(ABS(sr.qty) * COALESCE(m.units_per_box, 1)) AS total_base_cups FROM sales_returns AS sr JOIN materials AS m ON sr.material_id = m.material_id WHERE sr.status = 'C' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many base cups physically entered inventory from posted purchases, counting each movement once?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(si.qty * CASE WHEN si.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS total_base_cups FROM stock_in AS si JOIN materials AS m ON si.material_id = m.material_id WHERE si.source_type = 'purchase' AND si.status = 'posted' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many extra stock-in export rows are replays of an existing movement?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS replay_count FROM (SELECT movement_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM stock_in GROUP BY movement_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS t LIMIT 200

records.question: What is the tax-inclusive total value of approved sales orders in CNY?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(line_tax_amount) AS total_tax_inclusive_value FROM sales WHERE status = 'approved' LIMIT 200

records.question: What is the largest approved sales order's tax-inclusive total in CNY? Return only the amount.
records.final_sql: SELECT MAX(order_total) FROM sales WHERE status = 'approved' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many base cups physically entered inventory from completed production? Count each physical receipt once.
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(pr.qty * CASE WHEN pr.unit = 'cup' THEN 1 ELSE m.units_per_box END) AS total_base_cups FROM production_receipts AS pr JOIN materials AS m ON pr.material_id = m.material_id WHERE pr.status = 'completed' LIMIT 200

records.question: What is the total physical inventory inflow in base cups from all posted sources, including production and returns? Count each movement once.
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(si.qty * CASE WHEN si.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS total_cups FROM stock_in AS si JOIN materials AS m ON si.material_id = m.material_id WHERE si.status = 'posted' LIMIT 200

records.question: What is the highest valid measured stock-out weight in kg across all export rows?
records.final_sql: SELECT MAX(CAST(weight_text AS DECIMAL(18, 2))) AS max_weight_kg FROM stock_out WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(weight_text, '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 200

records.question: What is the average valid measured stock-out weight in kg across all export rows, excluding unavailable readings? Round to 4 decimal places.
records.final_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(weight_text AS DECIMAL(18, 4))), 4) AS avg_weight FROM stock_out WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(weight_text, '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 200

records.question: How many stock-in export rows are posted? This is a raw-row diagnostic; include replay rows.
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS posted_count FROM stock_in WHERE status = 'posted' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many stock-in export rows are not posted? This is a raw-row diagnostic; include replay rows.
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM stock_in WHERE status = 'draft' LIMIT 200

records.question: How many material master records are there?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM materials LIMIT 200
